items.title: Everyone’s Arguing About Taxing the Rich. Almost Nobody Noticed the $1 Trillion Already Slipping Past the IRS
items.summary: While politicians battle over wealth taxes and fair shares, a legal industry worth well over a trillion dollars is already engineering those rates into irrelevance for the nation's biggest fortunes, and it is growing faster than any bill Congress could pass.

items.title: Why higher yields aren't scaring off retail traders
items.summary: Charles Schwab Head Trading & Derivatives Strategist Joe Mazzola joins Jared Blikre to break down how higher Treasury yields are impacting retail traders—and what it means for their portfolios and trading strategies.

items.title: Can LPL Financial Sustain Its Strong Asset-Gathering Momentum?
items.summary: Can LPLA sustain strong asset growth and advisory momentum as moderating organic NNA and lower cash balances create uncertainty over future growth?

items.title: Wall Street Calls It “Tax Alpha.” It’s a $1 Trillion Machine for Beating the IRS Instead of the Market
items.summary: Wealthy investors have found a way to legally manufacture losses worth multiples of their initial investment, and the strategy just crossed a trillion dollars in assets before regulators started calling it potentially abusive.

items.title: The Ultra-Rich Pay Millions for “Tax-Loss Harvesting.” Here’s the Free Version Every Retiree With a Brokerage Account Can Run Before December 31
items.summary: Hedge funds charge millions to run a tax strategy that quietly trims what the ultra-wealthy owe each year, but the core mechanic sits inside your brokerage account right now, waiting for a deadline most retirees miss.

items.title: Schwab Raises the Minimum Account Size for Clients to Be Referred to Outside Advisors
items.summary: The company plans to increase the minimum account size for the Schwab Advisor Network to $5 million from $2 million at the beginning of next year.

items.title: Which Is the Better International ETF, Vanguard's VEA Targeting Developed Markets or Schwab's Emerging Market-Focused SCHE?
items.summary: Vanguard's lower 0.03% expense ratio and $316 billion in assets make it the larger, cheaper option, while Schwab's emerging markets focus offers higher growth potential with concentrated tech exposure.

items.title: Why Is Charles Schwab (SCHW) Up 10% Since Last Earnings Report?
